items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: And the band was Benny Morton on trombone, Yank Lawson, Billy Butterfield, Bud Freeman, Bob Wilber, Gus Johnson on drums, Bob Haggart and myself.

ctx.x: But we had a great band. And a guy sent me a tape, a cassette, from Minneapolis. We played in a place, oh this goes back to the early ‘70s. And we played a place outside of Minneapolis, called the Emporium of Jazz. And the band was Benny Morton on trombone, Yank Lawson, Billy Butterfield, Bud Freeman, Bob Wilber, Gus Johnson on drums, Bob Haggart and myself. And he recorded it one night when we were playing in there. And he sent me this tape. And I hadn’t heard it. And I’m going to the airport with my wife. We…
It was hot huh? It was swinging?
No, it's Robert Masters, and he would love that idea. He brings Ralph Sutton over.
